title: ValidationVerdict
description: Adversarial review verdict for a single finding. CANNOT emit new findings.

rationale.description: Why the finding stands or falls. Must engage with the evidence, not restate it.

crux.description: The single code fact the verdict hinges on — one sentence naming the exact function, constant value, or call site that decides it.

alternative_explanation.description: If rejected: the benign explanation. If confirmed: any rival hypothesis you ruled out.

missing_preconditions.description: Conditions that must hold for the bug to fire (sanitization upstream, config flags, etc.).

suggested_test.description: Concrete test that would disambiguate — e.g. a curl command, a unit test stub.

blockers.description: needs_more_info only: the exact unresolved facts that block a verdict.

validation_plan.description: needs_more_info only: how to resolve the blockers — at least one key.

production_viable.description: For paths guarded by an assert / debug flag / dev-mode env var: whether the bug still fires in a release configuration.

arbiter_severity.description: Arbiter-derived severity from enumerated missing_preconditions. Optional; when present the report prefers it over the hunter's claimed severity.

severity_reasoning.description: Required when arbiter_severity is set: the preconditions counted and the impact demonstrated, in that order.
